meta.title: Brayan Rodriguez Montealegre | Semi Senior Frontend Developer
meta.description: Semi Senior Frontend Developer with 3+ years of experience in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Specialized in frontend architecture, performance, testing, and observability.

hero.title: Hi, I'm Brayan
hero.description: 3+ years of experience. Semi Senior Frontend Developer from Neiva, Colombia. Specialized in frontend architecture, performance, testing, and observability with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

items.title: Semi Senior Frontend Developer
description: Developed a new version of a medical imaging viewer with React and TypeScript, modernizing its architecture and user experience and reducing image loading times by approximately 40%. The product later received FDA approval.
Implemented unit tests with over 95% frontend coverage, as well as backend tests to increase reliability and reduce regressions.
Modernized the backend in C# and .NET, migrating it to .NET 10 and applying Clean Architecture and hexagonal architecture to improve maintainability, decoupling, and scalability.
Developed a new version of the patient portal and implemented observability with New Relic to monitor errors, performance, and production load times.
Deployed applications with Docker and Kubernetes on AKS, reducing infrastructure costs by approximately 30% compared with Windows App Service.

items.title: Frontend Developer
description: Built responsive interfaces faithful to Figma designs with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind CSS, creating reusable components.
Integrated REST APIs and WebSockets for backend communication and real-time features.
Refactored existing components and flows to improve code maintainability, stability, and reuse.

items.title: Youtube Clone
items.description: Application that allows users to search and play videos, access video details such as views and likes, explore videos from the selected channel, and search videos by categories. Data is obtained through the RapidAPI YouTube v3 API, ensuring a seamless integration with real content.

items.title: Meals App
items.description: Site where users can explore a wide variety of foods, add their favorites to a personalized list, and get detailed information about any selected food. The platform also includes a search feature to quickly find foods of interest.

items.title: Netflix Clone
items.description: Application that uses the TMDB API to get all data about movies and series. User authentication is done through Firebase Authentication, allowing users to sign in and register securely. Additionally, Firestore is used to store the user's favorite movies or series.

items.title: Gym Landing Page
items.description: Gym landing page built with Astro, React.js, TailwindCSS, and JavaScript. Optimized for SEO, accessibility, and performance.

about.p1Start: My name is Brayan Rodriguez Montealegre.
about.p1Strong: I'm a software engineer and frontend developer
about.p1End: , committed to continuous learning and writing clean, reusable code. I'm passionate about applying best user experience practices, creating attractive, modern, and responsive interfaces. My ability to adapt to diverse circumstances and my constant pursuit of challenges allow me to improve every day.
about.p2: In my free time, I greatly value spending moments with my family and friends. I also enjoy going to the gym, which helps me stay active and balanced. My goal is to continue growing as a professional and as a person, always looking for new opportunities to learn and develop.
